info.biography: 字元图，南阳人。逢纪初到冀州时，因自身聪慧有计谋，颇受袁绍信任。逢纪提议袁绍应连结公孙瓒威压韩馥，谋求一州自立。逢纪自恃聪慧，刚愎自用，因忌惮田丰刚直而屡次构陷田丰。袁绍死后，与审配共同伪造袁绍遗命立少子袁谭继位。后来受袁尚命跟随袁谭，因袁尚与袁谭军资不足被杀。
info.characteristic: 可以通过拼点限制他人出牌，拼点时可以与对手的拼点牌交换

implementationInterpretations.adoptedContract: A targeted owner may choose any currently legal other Pindian participant independently of the triggering card user. Primary wording does not restrict the opponent; shipped BiGuo uses a one-target non-self selector supplied by server. No authenticated server selection list is claimed.

Each participant has one before-reveal opportunity for its single real shared Pindian card. The initiator may choose one real opponent, each opponent may choose only the initiator; choices follow current-turn-owner action order and keep one unique current physical-card assignment. Each committed swap rewards Draw2 only if its actually selected pair is won in the final native comparison. A skipped exchange earns no reward.
implementationInterpretations.authority: Explicit engineering interpretation of a single physical reveal per participant; no dedicated simultaneous Douyu FAQ verified.

implementationInterpretations.adoptedContract: After draining the real discard children, select one real current Deck entity per available printed major category with the engine PRNG. Reveal and obtain those exact entities; absent categories create no card, and the movement is not a Draw.
implementationInterpretations.authority: Engineering choice for unspecified within-category search order.

implementationInterpretations.topic: Repeated Biguo arms in one actual turn
implementationInterpretations.adoptedContract: Multiple completed draw-end arms for the same owner in one actual turn provide one optional Pindian opportunity per exact accepted whole Use. The earliest still-valid arm supplies that opportunity; identical same-name target windows do not duplicate a contest.
implementationInterpretations.authority: Engineering deduplication of the same skill trigger; no dedicated repeated-Draw FAQ verified.

Complete official portrait retained without local edits.

runtimeBoundaries: Real DrawPhaseEnded HE discard children before revealed category obtain; obtain never becomes Draw and missing categories never create entities.
Each accepted actual designated Use retains an exact paid Biguo arm and one native opponent selection, including a different legal other from its card user.

Final native Pindian result publishes printed-category bans before claims and bonus draws; Use and Played are gated by final effective output kind while discard, gifts, Pindian and Recast remain legal.
A declared existing Use retains its real additional-target queries after a new ban; the next forced new Slash is still prohibited.
Pair and simultaneous Douyu preserve original entity/payment-zone invoices and one physical assignment permutation, blind choices, native rank modifiers and claims.
Paid native draw children may lose source or kill the recipient; the living original opponent can finish the exact paid claim without duplicating draw or cleanup.
Exact retired Biguo Pindian movement batches resume their owning program before the original Use continues.
Native TurnEnded releases type bans before a real Dianjun tail Play in the same actual turn number.
